acceptance_predicates.description: The TUI negotiates and decodes the additive v1.15 ControlServer provider-catalog contract, preserving typed older-server/unavailable behavior.
Every eligible ASB OpenRouter explicit :free and free-router model is projected into wizard selection with provider profile, generation, digest, and capability identity intact.
Stale, unknown, unavailable, model-mismatch, provider-profile, generation, and digest mismatches fail closed before selection or dispatch.
Human and --json diagnostics are stable, actionable, and contain no credentials or raw provider payloads.
Explicit live mode never silently falls back to static development catalog, mock provider, or offline replay; missing development auth/signatures/keys remain warnings.
Installed asb tui install followed by bare asb tui qualifies the paired ASB/TUI dynamic-catalog journey at exact heads.
